summary: Revalidated Fluence Energy with current SEC-filed fiscal Q2 2026 evidence, a fresh USD 13.51 market mark, and current USD/EUR data. USD 5.6 billion of backlog confirms direct storage exposure, but 10.0% GAAP gross margin, first-half operating cash use of USD 347.9 million, project concentration, and thin adjusted-EBITDA guidance constrain quality. A bounded 12-month revenue sensitivity gives USD 7.35 downside and USD 14.73 base values, implying -45.6% and +9.1%; the medium-confidence baseline assessment is uncompetitive with cash, so no conviction strategy follow-up was created.

evidence.source: Fluence Energy fiscal Q2 2026 earnings release filed with the SEC
evidence.claim: Fluence reported fiscal Q2 revenue of USD 464.9 million, a 10.0% GAAP gross margin, USD 5.6 billion of backlog, and approximately USD 2.0 billion of fiscal-year order intake through 6 May. Management reaffirmed fiscal-2026 revenue guidance of USD 3.2-3.6 billion and adjusted-EBITDA guidance of USD 40-60 million.

At 31 March 2026, unrestricted cash was USD 387.3 million, cash including restricted cash was USD 412.9 million, convertible notes were USD 391.7 million, and six-month operating cash outflow was USD 347.9 million. As of 1 May, 132.811 million Class A shares and 51.499 million Class B-1 shares were outstanding; the top three customers represented approximately 45% of first-half revenue.

evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic market and FX caches
evidence.claim: FLNC closed at USD 13.510000228881836 on 2026-07-27 with volume 8,423,118, and the USD/EUR rate was 0.8792999982833862 for 2026-07-27; both were retrieved at 2026-07-27T22:30:44Z and market status was ok.

Using the USD 3.4 billion fiscal-2026 revenue-guidance midpoint, 184.310685 million Class A plus Class B-1 economic interests, and USD -4.408 million of net cash before restricted cash, a 0.4x revenue downside case gives USD 7.35 per share (-45.6%) and a 0.8x base case gives USD 14.73 (+9.1%) versus the current mark. Base upside is below the configured 20% margin-of-safety requirement.
